source_custody.source_sentence: HCMV immediate-early proteins were clearly shown to be responsible for elevating p53 levels in infected fibroblasts; expression of HCMV immediate-early region 1 and 2 proteins resulted in elevation of p53 levels in transfected human fibroblasts.

source_general_rationale.compositional_semantics: In the construction X was responsible for elevating Y, X controls the understood subject of the non-finite elevating event. The source therefore entails that X causally participates in that inner event.
source_general_rationale.minimal_graph_semantics: The mandatory outer links already encode X as the causal agent of an outer responsibility relation whose effect is the inner elevation event. A direct X-to-inner-event CAUSAL_AGENT edge repeats that entailed relation without adding independent scientific content.
source_general_rationale.generalization_boundary: The verdict applies to a source-supported controlled non-finite complement whose controller is already the causal agent of an explicit outer event linked to that complement. It does not authorize propagating outer participants into arbitrary nested events.
source_general_rationale.scientific_conclusion: The direct edge is an entailed redundant closure edge. It is neither required for a lossless minimal graph nor a scientific overclaim.

v14_local_evaluator_policy.acceptance_rule: Compare all mandatory source-semantic links exactly after removing at most one mapped optional edge matching the frozen tuple above. Record the removed edge as ACCEPTED_SOURCE_ENTAILED_REDUNDANCY.
v14_local_evaluator_policy.target_binding_rule: The optional edge is admissible only when proteins resolves to the independently accepted complete participant occurrence and elevating resolves to the independently accepted inner event occurrence.
fail_closed_conditions: The mandatory outer CAUSAL_AGENT or EFFECT_EVENT link is absent.
